Wakflow The platform 02

Everything a growing business needs to answer, sell, book and follow up — working as one.

Wakflow connects your WhatsApp number, your team's shared inbox, your CRM, your AI assistant and the automation that ties them together — so a new enquiry is answered in seconds, saved with its source, and followed up without anyone copying it between apps by hand.

How it works

  1. 1A customer gets in touchWhatsApp, Instagram DM or comment, website form, chat or email.
  2. 2An AI answers first24x7, from your own prices and policies, in the customer's language. Hot leads get a call back within a minute.
  3. 3The lead is savedIn your CRM with its source and interest, plus a follow-up task for your team.
  4. 4A human takes overThe full conversation sits in the shared inbox; the right person picks it up and the AI steps aside.
  5. 5Follow-ups run by themselvesConfirmations, payment reminders, offers and feedback requests — no one pressing send.
  6. 6You stay in controlOne short morning report from your AI assistant, and nightly backups of everything.
